visualCharacteristics.purpose: two-up event cards: wide banner image with a date badge overlay, tags, title, description
visualCharacteristics.summary: 2-up wide banner image with date badge overlay, tags, title, description

contentPattern.structure: one row per event. Cell 1: banner image. Cell 2, in order: date paragraph (e.g. "24 Nov 2026 | De 16:00 a 17:00 | Online", parts split by | or line breaks; a leading day number becomes the large figure), bulleted list of tags, title (H3) linked to the event page, description paragraph. The image links to the title link
contentPattern.summary: Próximos eventos en directo: Dynamic list: items link to event detail pages and carry date and tags

reuseGuidance: Use for dated events. For undated articles use cards-news.
